item.title: [+1] Analysts forecast ocean freight spot rates falling 30% in 2027 as Red Sea routes reopen
item.description:
Capacity is flooding back as shipping lines return to the Red Sea; some firms now coordinate passage with the Houthis. New outlook.

FMCG & consumer: mild tailwind (+1) — Cheaper imports

Why it matters: Cheaper container freight would lower costs for Indian exporters and importers and ease goods inflation next year.

Market gauges: Inflation outlook +1, Growth outlook +1

Confidence: low · horizon: months
